map.安全评估：算 Goodman 利用率与安全系数，判断有限寿命还是无限寿命: Safety evaluation: compute Goodman utilization and safety factor, judge finite or infinite life
map.算法：Goodman 等效应力幅 σa_eq = σa×σb/(σb−σm)；S: Algorithm: Goodman equivalent stress amplitude sigma a_eq = sigma a times sigma b / (sigma b minus sigma m); Soderberg takes yield approximation sigma s0 = 0.5 sigma b, sigma a_Sod = sigma a times sigma s0 / (sigma s0 minus sigma m); Gerber: sigma a_Ger = sigma a / (1 minus (sigma m / sigma b) squared); fatigue limit sigma(-1) = 0.5 sigma b; Basquin: Nf = 0.5 times (sigma a_eq / sigma f prime) to the (1/b) (b less than 0); Goodman utilization = sigma a / sigma(-1) plus sigma m / sigma b, safety factor = 1 / utilization.
map.例：σa=200MPa、σm=100MPa、σb=800MPa、σf'=1200: Example: sigma a = 200 MPa, sigma m = 100 MPa, sigma b = 800 MPa, sigma f prime = 1200 MPa, b = minus 0.12 gives Goodman equivalent stress amplitude 228.57 MPa, Soderberg 266.67 MPa, Gerber 203.17 MPa, fatigue limit 400 MPa, Nf about 5.02e5 cycles (Soderberg 1.39e5 cycles, Gerber 1.34e6 cycles), Goodman utilization 62.5%, safety factor 1.60, judged as below fatigue limit, theoretically infinite life. If sigma a rises to 350 MPa, sigma m = 150 MPa, equivalent stress amplitude 430.77 MPa exceeds the fatigue limit, Nf drops sharply to 2.55e3 cycles, utilization 106.3%, safety factor 0.94.
map.Goodman / Gerber / Soderberg 该用哪个？: Which to use, Goodman / Gerber / Soderberg?
map.Goodman 居中、最常用；Gerber 对韧性材料更接近试验但偏乐观；Sod: Goodman is in the middle and most commonly used; Gerber is closer to tests for ductile materials but optimistic; Soderberg uses yield strength as the criterion and is most conservative. For safety-critical parts it is recommended to also look at the Soderberg result and take the lower bound.
map.b 和 σf' 怎么取？: How to choose b and sigma f prime?
map.b 为疲劳强度指数，钢材常取 −0.085~−0.12；σf' 为疲劳强度系数，: b is the fatigue strength exponent, steel commonly minus 0.085 to minus 0.12; sigma f prime is the fatigue strength coefficient, approximately 1.0 to 1.2 times the tensile strength. Both are best regressed from the material S-N curve, manual values are only initial estimates.
